workout.warmup: Incline walk · 8–10 min · 3.3–3.5 mph · 6–8% incline — NOT optional on lower day, this is your back warmup.
workout.finisher: Incline walk · 10 min · 3.3–3.5 mph · 6–8% incline. Skip if session hits 65 min.
workout.coach_note: Rescheduled from Sunday — you hiked Spencer's Butte instead (nice leg work). Do this Monday IF your legs feel fresh; if the descent left your quads sore, push to Tuesday and make Monday rest/upper. Back is cleared, so the Hammer Strength hinge stays in and you can push it. Progressions are from your actual 7/2 numbers — PF machines run heavy, calibrate to feel.

exercises.name: Leg Press
exercises.note: You did 360 + ~167 sled for a clean 3x10 on 7/2. Bump one plate/notch and aim for 3x10 where set 3 is genuinely hard. Controlled, no lockout, knees tracking over toes.

exercises.name: Seated Leg Curl
exercises.note: Held 65 for 10/10/10 on 7/2. Same weight, but push for 11–12 this time before adding. Hamstrings are your weak link — if they feel tight, cap the last set at 10.

exercises.name: Hammer Strength Deadlift (Ground Base)
exercises.note: Back's cleared, so lean into this. You got 10/10/13 with 45s on 7/2 — that last set of 13 says add load: put a 10 or 25 per side and aim for 3x10–12. Guided path, hinge from the hips, squeeze glutes at the top, no lower-back rounding.

exercises.name: Leg Extension
exercises.note: You skipped this on 7/2 — get it in this time. Quad isolation, squeeze hard at the top, slow 2-count down. Pick a weight that burns on the last set.

exercises.name: Walking Lunge (DB)
exercises.note: You've owned 30 lb twice now with clean reps — if it feels strong on set 1, jump to 35 lb and see how it moves. Long step, drive through the heel, knee drive at the top.

exercises.name: Core Circuit (fresh combo) — 2 rounds
exercises.detail: Hanging Knee Raise x12 → Dead Bugs 10/side → Hollow Body Hold 25s
exercises.note: New combo, different from your last two sessions. Hollow body is back in now that your back's cleared — arms overhead, lower back pressed flat. If any lower-back complaint, swap hollow for a 30s side plank per side.
